DOMAIN_SEPARATOR().details: Returns the EIP-712 domain separator for the EIP-2612 permit.

addTaxVenue(address).details: The venue must be a contract that reports this token as its      `token0()` or `token1()` (v2 and v3 pools do). This stops a venue      admin from listing an arbitrary holder (a wallet, a cex, a safe)      to tax its outflows (VENUE) or freeze it (HARD). Venues without      that shape can still be pre listed via `addDerivedTaxVenue`.

allowance(address,address).details: Returns the amount of tokens that `spender` can spend on behalf of `owner`.

approve(address,uint256).details: Sets `amount` as the allowance of `spender` over the caller's tokens. Emits a {Approval} event.

attestCanonicalBudget(bytes32,uint256).details: Calls for another pool, another mode or a zero amount are no ops,      never reverts, so a hook misroute cannot brick a swap.

balanceOf(address).details: Returns the amount of tokens owned by `owner`.

params.canon: Canonical pool inputs from the factory.
params.launcher_: The factory. Receives the supply and is the `launcher` tag.
params.t: Token config. `totalSupply` is ignored; `supply` is what is minted.
params.tax: Tax config. See `_initTax` for the per mode rules.

decimals().details: Returns the decimals places of the token.

grantCanonicalFlow(bytes32,uint256,uint2.details: D34 netting. A canonical flow first cancels the outstanding      allowance of the opposite direction; only the remainder is      granted. HARD: out cancels unused in, in cancels unused out, so at      most one direction is ever outstanding and a round trip, a remove      then re add, or an add then remove inside one unlock leaves nothing      for a side pool take or settle. VENUE: `inAmount` (coin entering      the canonical pool: a sell or an lp add) cancels unused budget;      `outAmount` is ignored (budget is added by `attestCanonicalBudget`).      No op for another pool or in NONE.

name().details: Returns the name of the token.

nonces(address).details: Returns the current nonce for `owner`. This value is used to compute the signature for EIP-2612 permit.

permit(address,address,uint256,uint256,u.details: Sets `value` as the allowance of `spender` over the tokens of `owner`, authorized by a signed approval by `owner`. Emits a {Approval} event.

renounceAdmin().details: Freezes the rate, image, metadata and renderer. Does not touch the venue admin.

setMetadataRenderer(address).details: Zero falls back to the built in json. A non zero renderer must have code.

symbol().details: Returns the symbol of the token.

totalSupply().details: Returns the amount of tokens in existence.

transfer(address,uint256).details: Solady inlines balance moves in `transfer`/`transferFrom`, so both      are overridden and routed through `_route`. `transferFrom` debits      the full `amount` once (Permit2 short circuit preserved).

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: Transfers `amount` tokens from `from` to `to`. Note: Does not update the allowance if it is the maximum uint256 value. Requirements: - `from` must at least have `amount`. - The caller must have at least `amount` of allowance to transfer the tokens of `from`. Emits a {Transfer} event.

transferVenueAdmin(address).details: D48: single step, venue admin only. Not moved by `updateAdmin`.

MAX_NAME_BYTES().notice: D30 string caps in bytes, enforced at construction and in every         setter, so a renderer's gas budget is provable. The factory checks         the same caps before deploying.

addDerivedTaxVenue((uint8,address,bytes3.notice: Venue admin. Derives the v2/v3 pool address from this token and adds it.

addTaxVenue(address).notice: Venue admin. Add only, no removal path.

attestCanonicalBudget(bytes32,uint256).notice: VENUE mode: realized coin leaving the PoolManager from the         canonical pool this tx; exempts that much of PoolManager outflow.

constantsHash().notice: `Constants.hash()` of the build this contract was compiled with.

grantCanonicalFlow(bytes32,uint256,uint2.notice: HARD mode: per direction allowance for PoolManager transfers         this tx, cumulative, consumed exactly.

pendingCanonical().notice: Remaining same tx allowances. VENUE: (budget, 0, 0). HARD: (0, out, in).

taxBps().notice: Current rate in BPS, within [0, taxBpsMax]. VENUE mode only.

taxSink().notice: Constants.DEAD or the pool's bounty recipient.

taxVenues().notice: Listed v2/v3 venues (the PoolManager is implicit). <= MAX_TAX_VENUES.

transferVenueAdmin(address).notice: Venue admin. Freezes the venue list.D48, additive. Venue admin only, nonzero. Not moved by `updateAdmin`.
